subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Negotiation Fundamentals
description: A fast breakdown of Negotiation Fundamentals for builders.

hook.text: A buyer beats a supplier down to rock-bottom price. Next quarter, quality drops. Both sides lost.

buildup.text: Procurement negotiation seeks terms that meet the buyer's needs while keeping the supplier viable.

discovery.text: Win-win deals focus on total value: price, quality, payment terms, service levels, and innovation sharing.

twist.text: Hardball tactics win short-term savings but destroy trust. Suppliers retaliate with hidden cost increases.

climax.text: The best negotiators prepare obsessively—knowing costs, alternatives, and the supplier's constraints.

punchline.text: Good negotiation builds relationships, not resentment.

quiz.question: What should procurement negotiations focus on?
options: Total value including quality, service, and terms
